layers.prompt: Backdrop layer for a layered paper-theatre story diorama. Match exactly the hand-painted paper look, aged cardstock texture, brushwork and palette of the first reference, flat front view, filling the entire image. The kingdom at sunrise after the dawn has returned: a golden sun just above the rolling slate-blue hills, a warm rose and gold sky with scissor-cut paper clouds, a calm river winding through green fields inside its banks, a straight pale road running across the land to a far small palace on the horizon; high in the sky, small, the blue ice dragon of the second reference circling with wings spread; calm green meadow across the lower 35%. No characters other than the small dragon, no text, frame, border or vignette.
layers.postprocessing: Already 1536x1024 (the backdrop size): no crop or resize; tools/encode.py (WebP quality 80).
